_comment: Season Pass (Update 9, src/core/season.gd). Seasons are 14 local calendar days on a fixed calendar from Monday 2026-11-02 (season 1), numbered. 30 free tiers, 500 season XP each. 'xp' lists the season XP sources: every finished game in a rewarded mode, a win on top, every mission claimed and the Daily Challenge (first finished game of the day). 'tiers' are claimed on the Season screen; reward keys: coins, stars, packs (pack ids), uniform (true = this season's uniform, see 'uniforms'). After tier 30 every 'bonus.xp' season XP pays 'bonus.packs' automatically. At rollover every reached tier that was not claimed is paid out. 'uniforms' are the gear.json uniform ids handed out at tier 30, one per season, cycling; a uniform the manager already owns pays 'uniform_owned_stars' instead. Sized with tools/balance/economy.py: about 1 hour of play a day reaches tier 30 on day 11-12 of 14.
